fields.subject: ShardKeySerialization
fields.trigger: ThrowIfMetadataMismatch is invoked with the call-site key type(s) and previously-saved metadata bytes
fields.response: throw InvalidShardKeyMetadataException with no type argument when the recomputed metadata's length differs from the supplied metadata's length; throw InvalidShardKeyMetadataException naming only the single first-position call-site type (keyType) -- never the call-site type that actually failed to encode -- when any call-site type fails to encode to a KeyDataType; otherwise compare the recomputed packed bytes to the supplied bytes position by position and throw InvalidShardKeyMetadataException naming keyType for a position-0 mismatch, childType for position-1, or grandchildType for position-2; in the four-type overload the position-2 byte also carries the greatgrandchildType's full packed 6-bit code alongside grandchildType's two low bits, so a position-2 mismatch there is still reported as grandchildType regardless of which of the two co-located codes actually changed
fields.postcondition: it returns normally, without throwing, only when every recomputed packed byte -- for whichever subset of positions the invoked overload's arity defines -- exactly matches the supplied metadata
